svg.title: One Step to the Perfect Hotel
svg.text: One Step to the Perfect Hotel
Finds what hotel listings never mention: sea view, real quiet,
beach access, mountain sun. Every fact keeps its source and
confidence. Sochi coast and Krasnaya Polyana.
Geo-analytics: street-noise model per facade, floor and
hour, checked against guest reviews; beach routes,
